answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Elevated master butcher licence with butchers association attestation flips the bet — a licence the association renews after shop audits — and the wharf lands on the attacker instead. The economics flip: the network spends pennies verifying, the attacker spends real money proving, and the dawn of that gap is the whole defence in one line. Scale is the enemy of the attacker here. The harbor grows with every clone, but the reward per clone stays fixed, so the farm goes broke before it goes big.
